21.why_use: Purane zamaane mein files transfer karne ke liye, lekin ab outdated hai
21.beginner_explanation: FTP ek tarah ka dak ghar hai jo files bhejta hai server tak. Lekin problem ye hai ke saari information open likhi hoti hai - koi bhi dekh sakta hai!
21.why_dangerous: Passwords plain text mein bhejta hai jo network par visible hote hain. Hackers logon ko steal kar sakte hain
21.alternative: SFTP (Secure FTP) ya SCP use karo jo encrypted hote hain
21.quick_fix: FTP service ko completely band kar do. SFTP install karo
21.detection_method: Scan karke dekho, agar 21 khula hai to problem hai

22.why_use: Server ko remotely control karte ho - safe aur secure tarike se
22.beginner_explanation: SSH ek secure telephone line hai. Jab tum server se baat karte ho to encryption hota hai. Koi sunnah nahi sakta!
22.why_important: Modern servers ke liye zaroori hai. Sirf SSH ko firewall se restrict karo, band mat karo
best_practices: SSH keys use karo (password ke bajai)
Public networks par VPN use karo
Firewall se IP-based access set karo
22.quick_fix: Password-based login disable karo, SSH keys use karo
22.detection_method: SSH banner grab karo version dekne ke liye

23.why_use: Bahut purana remote access method - 1970s se chalra hai
23.beginner_explanation: TELNET bilkul khule telephone par baat karna hai. Koi bhi Sun sakta hai, password bhi! KABHI USE MAT KARO!
23.why_dangerous: SABKUCH PLAIN TEXT! Passwords, commands, sab kuch network par dikhta hai. Ye 1970s ka technology hai
do_not: TELNET PORT 23 KABHI OPEN MAT RAKHO
Kisi purane device ke liye bhi legacy networking use karo
23.replacement: SSH (Port 22) - ye safe aur modern hai
23.quick_fix: TELNET service completely band kar do. SSH install karo
23.detection_method: Scan karo - agar 23 khula hai to immediately band karo!

25.why_use: Email servers port 25 use karte hain emails send karne ke liye
25.beginner_explanation: SMTP ek postal system hai jo emails deliver karta hai. Lekin agar lockdown nahi hai to koi bhi spam emails bhej sakta hai
25.why_dangerous: Open relay configuration se spammers usse mass emails bhejte hain. Server ke reputation ko nuke kar dete hain
25.when_to_open: Sirf agar ye mail server hai aur properly configured ho
25.quick_fix: SMTP relay ko close karo, authentication enable karo
25.detection_method: Connect karo port 25 par aur dekho relay possible hai ya nahi

80.why_use: Website hosting - Internet par website dikhane ke liye
80.beginner_explanation: Port 80 wo highway hai jiska use log website dekh sakte hain. Lekin ye encryption nahi karta - sirf public info ke liye theek hai
80.why_important: Websites ke liye zaroori hai. Lekin sensitive data ke liye nahi
80.security_notes: Port 80 sirf non-sensitive content ke liye use karo. Login, payments, sab kuch HTTPS (443) se ho
80.quick_fix: HTTPS enable karo, HTTP ko redirect karo HTTPS ko
80.detection_method: Browser mein website kholo aur dekho HTTPS hai ya nahi

443.why_use: Secure website - encryption ke saath sabkuch safe aur secure
443.beginner_explanation: Port 443 ek encrypted highway hai. Jab tum password daalo ya credit card number - ye encryption mein bhar jata hai. Koi sunnah nahi sakta
443.why_important: Modern web ke liye HTTPS zaroori hai. Banking, shopping, social media - sabkuch HTTPS se ho
best_practices: TLS 1.2 ya 1.3 use karo - purane versions disable karo
443.quick_fix: Free SSL certificate lelo Let's Encrypt se aur lagao
443.detection_method: Browser mein lock icon dekho - ye matlab HTTPS hai

3306.why_use: Website ka data store karta hai - user accounts, posts, sab kuch
3306.beginner_explanation: MySQL ek digital vault hai jismein pura website ka data rakha hota hai. Agar ye khul gaya to hackers ko sabkuch mil jata hai!
3306.why_dangerous: KABHI KABHI INTERNET PAR EXPOSED! Hackers ne millions records steal kiye hain. Password, emails, sab kuch leak
never_do: Database ko Internet par exposed mat rakho
Port 3306 firewall se public access se band kar do
Database ko root user se run mat karo
Database mein weak passwords mat rakh
best_practices: Database sirf localhost (127.0.0.1) se accessible hona chahiye
Firewall se port 3306 publicly accessible nahi hona chahiye
Principle of least privilege - sirf zaroori permissions do
3306.quick_fix: MySQL ki access localhost tak restrict karo: bind-address = 127.0.0.1
3306.detection_method: Port scan karo - agar 3306 open hai to alarm!

3389.why_use: Windows server ko graphically access karte ho - desktop dekh sakte ho
3389.beginner_explanation: RDP ek remote TV screen ke jaisa hai. Attacker ko pura desktop dekh aur control karne ka access milta hai. BlueKeep vulnerability se bina login ke bhi access possible tha!
3389.why_dangerous: BlueKeep (CVE-2019-0708) se bina login ke server pwned ho sakta tha! RDP brute force attacks common hain
never_do: RDP ko Internet par exposed mat rakho
Default port 3389 ko public internet se access hona nahi chahiye
Weak passwords mat use karo RDP par
best_practices: RDP sirf VPN se access karo
Firewall se port 3389 block karo public from
Alternative ports use karo (3389 nahi, koi aur)
3389.quick_fix: VPN setup karo aur RDP sirf VPN se accessible banao
3389.detection_method: Port scan - agar 3389 open hai to VPN se hi access karo

6379.why_use: Fast caching - website ko super fast banane ke liye
6379.beginner_explanation: Redis ek ultra-fast memory storage hai. Lekin default mein password nahi hota! Internet par expose karo to sabkuch hack hota hai
6379.why_dangerous: DEFAULT MEIN PASSWORD NAHI! Koi bhi connect karke data le sakta hai ya delete kar sakta hai. Ransomware ka target raha hai
6379.critical_issue: Redis Internet par exposed hone se RAKHENA-WIPER jaise ransomware ne lakhs servers ko ransom kar diya
best_practices: Redis sirf localhost se accessible hona chahiye
Firewall se public access block karo
requirepass set karo strong password ke saath
Monitoring setup karo suspicious activity detect karne ke liye
6379.quick_fix: bind 127.0.0.1 set karo redis config mein
6379.detection_method: Redis port scan - agar open ho to immediately fix karo!

27017.why_use: Flexible database - JSON-like documents store karta hai
27017.beginner_explanation: MongoDB ek modern vault hai. Lekin purane versions mein password nahi tha! Internet par expose karo to pura data leak
27017.why_dangerous: PEHLE DEFAULT AUTHENTICATION NAHI THA! Hackers ne millions databases expose kiye - patients records, emails, passwords - sabkuch leak
horror_stories: 2017 mein 27 million MongoDB records leak hua Chinese hospital se
Uber ke data leak mein exposed databases the
Multiple healthcare companies ka data publicly available tha
best_practices: MongoDB sirf internal networks par accessible hona chahiye
Authentication enable karo - definitely require username + password
Firewall se public access completely block karo
Encryption enable karo data transmission ke liye
27017.quick_fix: Pehle enable authentication, fir firewall block karo
27017.detection_method: MongoDB port 27017 scan - exposed ho to alert!

5432.why_use: Enterprise database - robust, reliable aur powerful
5432.beginner_explanation: PostgreSQL ek professional vault hai banking-level security ke saath. Lekin agar misconfigured ho to vulnerable ban sakta hai
5432.why_important: PostgreSQL bahut secure hota hai agar properly configured ho. Lekin agar public ho to danger
best_practices: Firewall se public access block karo
5432.detection_method: Port scan 5432 - agar exposed ho to dangerous!

5984.why_use: Distributed document database - flexibility ke saath scalability
5984.beginner_explanation: CouchDB ek flexible database hai jo spread out ho sakta hai multiple servers par. Lekin admin party mode dangerous hota hai
5984.why_dangerous: Admin party mode mein koi bhi admin ban sakta hai - pura database modify/delete ho sakta hai
best_practices: Admin party mode disable karo - CRITICAL
Firewall se public access block karo
5984.quick_fix: CouchDB config mein admin user create karo aur admin party disable karo
5984.detection_method: Scan karo - agar 5984 open hai without authentication to alert!
